title: US Presidential Election Winner 2028
question: Who will win the 2028 US presidential election?
summary: Polling remains volatile, but prediction-market pricing and macro sentiment both favor candidates with stronger fundraising and incumbent coalition support.
evidence_points: Recent polling averages still show a tight race rather than a runaway favorite.
Fundraising strength and state-level organization continue to matter more than single-day headlines.
Late-breaking macro data can materially shift prediction-market pricing.

title: NBA Finals Winner 2027
question: Which team will win the 2027 NBA Finals?
summary: Rotation health, postseason shot quality, and matchup-specific defense drive the highest-information edge in this market.
evidence_points: Healthy star usage and half-court offense remain leading signals in playoff series pricing.
Market mispricings often emerge after injury news before deeper lineup context is absorbed.
Teams with stronger transition defense tend to sustain value in seven-game series.

title: Major Hurricane Landfall This Season
question: Will a major hurricane make landfall this season?
summary: Sea-surface temperatures and storm-path conditions support an above-average risk profile, but landfall markets remain sensitive to track changes near resolution.
evidence_points: Warm water anomalies raise the background probability of stronger storms.
Track uncertainty compresses late and creates sharp repricing windows.
Seasonal basin activity does not always translate to landfall in populated regions.
